sections.text_helper: Section 11.3.7 "I/O alternate function input/output" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 343.
sections.section_content:
Two registers are provided to select one of the alternate function inputs/outputs available for
each I/O. With these registers, the user can connect an alternate function to some other pin
as required by the application.
This means that some peripheral functions are multiplexed on each GPIO using the
GPIOx_AFRL and GPIOx_AFRH alternate function registers. The application can thus
select any one of the possible functions for each I/O. The AF selection signal being common
to the alternate function input and alternate function output, a single channel is selected for
the alternate function input/output of a given I/O.
To know which functions are multiplexed on each GPIO pin, refer to the device datasheet.
